sum: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar® U.S. Dividend Growth IndexSM (the “underlying index”), which is a dividend dollar-weighted index that seeks to measure the performance of U.S. companies selected based on a consistent history of growing dividends. The underlying index may include large-, mid- and small-capitalization companies.
